turns.replyTail:

Can I change the shipping address on an order I just placed?

Hey! Possibly, but only if the order hasn’t been fulfilled yet. Please send over your email used at checkout or order number so I can better assist.

Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?

No—orders can’t be canceled after they’re placed, and there isn’t a cancellation window. Orders are processed right away, so once submitted, they move too fast to cancel or modify.

turns.q: Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
turns.replyTail:
n I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?

No—orders can’t be canceled after they’re placed, and there isn’t a cancellation window. Orders are processed right away, so once submitted, they move too fast to cancel or modify.

Can I add an item to an order I already placed?

No, items can’t be added to an order after it’s been placed. Orders move into processing too quickly to modify, so the best option is to place a separate order for the additional item.

What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
